# Scalix Labs — Comprehensive System & Entity Guide

> Scalix Labs (https://www.scalixlabs.in) is a digital engineering and performance growth agency. We specialize in building conversion-focused websites, custom software applications, and predictable customer acquisition systems. We design and develop solutions across EdTech, Real Estate, Co-Living, SaaS, E-Commerce, and modern service industries.

## About Scalix Labs
Scalix Labs operates at the intersection of modern full-stack web engineering and performance marketing. Rather than building static digital brochures, Scalix Labs engineers "revenue engines"—digital platforms designed specifically to capture buyer attention, rank organically, convert traffic into qualified conversations, and scale predictably.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Conversion-Focused Web Development
We engineer high-performance web experiences using modern technologies (Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript). 
- Custom UX/UI design centered on customer journey mapping
- Sub-second page loads deployed on global CDN infrastructure
- Mobile-first responsiveness and interactive animations
- Integrated conversion pathways (WhatsApp, booking modals, direct calendar scheduling)
- Complete technical SEO and Schema.org structured data

### 2. Custom Software & Web Application Development
Bespoke software platforms engineered for unique operational and client-facing workflows:
- SaaS Platforms & Multi-tenant Applications
- Real Estate Portals & Co-living Booking Engines
- Custom CRM & Internal Management Dashboards
- Database Architecture (PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis)
- API Development & Webhook Integrations

### 3. Performance Marketing
Full-funnel advertising across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn:
- Search, Display, and YouTube campaigns
- Audience segmentation and custom pixel tracking (GA4, CAPI)
- Systematic creative testing frameworks
- Retargeting flows to capture abandoned visitors

### 4. Lead Generation Systems
Automated acquisition systems that filter low-quality prospects and route high-intent buyers into active sales conversations:
- Funnel architecture and dedicated landing pages
- Lead qualification forms and scoring logic
- Instant WhatsApp and email follow-up automations

### 5. SEO & Organic Discovery (including GEO / LLM Search)
Positioning brands for sustainable organic search visibility across traditional engines (Google, Bing) and generative AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude):
- Technical SEO audits and Core Web Vitals optimization
- Structured JSON-LD entity data (Organization, Services, FAQPage)
- LLM optimization through machine-readable formats (llms.txt)

## Detailed Client Case Studies

### 1. YUKTA VERSE — AI & Technology Learning Platform
- **URL**: https://yuktaverse.com
- **Case Study Page**: https://www.scalixlabs.in/work/yuktaverse
- **Sector**: EdTech & Technology Career Acceleration
- **The Challenge**: Needed a comprehensive digital platform to articulate career tracks, communicate mentor trust, showcase capstone projects, and capture course enrollment inquiries.
- **What Scalix Labs Built**: Full-stack Next.js web platform, clear course discovery architecture, mentor trust sections, interactive consultation funnels, and high-performance mobile UI.
- **Result**: 150% increase in learner inquiries and verified enrollment interest.

### 2. SLN HOMES — Co-Living & Residential Platform
- **URL**: https://www.slnhomes.in
- **Case Study Page**: https://www.scalixlabs.in/work/sln-homes
- **Sector**: Real Estate & Co-Living (Bengaluru, Karnataka)
- **The Challenge**: Rental seekers in Bangalore's tech hubs make rapid mobile decisions. SLN Homes needed an intuitive room showcase with direct booking channels.
- **What Scalix Labs Built**: Mobile-first rental discovery platform featuring 2/3 sharing and 1 BHK layouts, landmark distance markers (Silk Board, Electronic City, Metro), verified amenity badges, and one-tap WhatsApp visit scheduling.
- **Result**: +240% surge in qualified inbound room inquiries and tour appointments.

### 3. V2 PROPERTIES — Luxury Real Estate Discovery & Advisory
- **Sector**: Luxury Real Estate & Commercial Property Consultancy
- **Case Study Page**: https://www.scalixlabs.in/work/v2-properties
- **The Challenge**: High-net-worth home buyers and investors require sophisticated architectural presentation without cluttered, generic classifieds.
- **What Scalix Labs Built**: Upscale real estate showcase platform highlighting luxury apartments, villas, and commercial spaces with direct developer advisory funnels and investor lead qualification.
- **Result**: Highly qualified, high-ticket investor leads and seamless consultation scheduling.

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Next.js Server Components, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, SQLite
- **Deployment & Infrastructure**: Vercel Edge Network, AWS, Docker
- **Integrations & Automation**: WhatsApp Business API, n8n automation, Nodemailer, Google Analytics 4
